description: Defines the class interface for ProgramVk, implementing Vulkan-specific shader program management, including shader initialization, descriptor set management, pipeline creation, and uniform handling within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: ProgramVk
classes.description: Vulkan-specific implementation of shader program management, including shader compilation, descriptor set handling, pipeline creation, and uniform updates.

classes.name: ProgramVk::ShaderInfo
classes.description: Holds shader compilation and helper objects for vertex and compute shaders within ProgramVk.

methods.name: UseLineRaster
methods.description: Inline function to determine if line rasterization should be used based on context features and primitive mode.
